items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Eddie Bo wrote this, we sat down in a studio on Rampart Street... And me and Eddie Bo, we used to talk about this all the time.

ctx.x: That's Joe Hinn. Now this is Joe Asanto from One Stop Records.

Oh, okay. And what's the name of the song? All My Love Belongs To You. This is a tune that was written by the same man that wrote I Love You. Yes, I Do, I With Your Honor. Oh, okay. And Eddie Bo wrote this, I Want Some Money. Now this is, we're going to talk about this. This is interesting. I Want Some Money. When we went, when I, Eddie Bo wrote this, we sat down in a studio on Rampart Street. And boy, we had this so nice and funky.
